run_commonsense_qa_preprocessing: run the CommonsenseQA preprocessing script to generate 32-shot k-shot data for multiple random seeds
run_more_shots_preprocessing: run the main_more_shots function to generate k-shot data with shot counts from 64 to 4096
create_commonsenseqa_dataset_class: create a CommonsenseQA dataset class that inherits from FewshotGymTextToTextDataset and loads the commonsense_qa HuggingFace dataset
review_get_choices_and_answer_string: review the get_choices_and_answer_string method that extracts choices and the correct answer from a CommonsenseQA datapoint
summarize_map_hf_dataset_to_list: summarize the map_hf_dataset_to_list method that converts a HuggingFace dataset split into a list of question-answer tuples
